dict.string: HKFitness needs camera access to capture photos and video for your activity tracking.
HKFitness needs motion access to track your activity, steps, and movement in real-time.
HKFitness needs permission to access your photo library.
HKFitness needs permission to save photos and videos to your library.
HKFitness needs access to read your health data including heart rate, steps, and active energy.
HKFitness needs access to write health data for tracking purposes.
